column2: [Endure]: Immune to knockback, knock-up and stagger effects.\nThe disabled actions configured for [Endure] in the abnormal status table only grant immunity to the [Knock-up] and [Knockback] implemented in blueprints.

column1: 【免控】免疫击退、击飞、眩晕、冰冻、石化、沉默、定身、黑暗效果。\n异常状态表中【免控】配置的禁止行为仅对蓝图中实现的【击飞】【击退】进行免疫。\n对于眩晕、冰冻、石化、沉默、定身、黑暗效果的免疫通过buff逻辑中的bufftag（_kBuffCategory1）进行实现。
column2: [Immunity] Immune to knockback, knock-up, stun, freeze, petrify, silence, root and blind effects.\nThe disabled actions configured for [Immunity] in the abnormal status table only grant immunity to the [Knock-up] and [Knockback] implemented in blueprints.\nImmunity to stun, freeze, petrify, silence, root and blind is implemented via the bufftag (_kBuffCategory1) in the buff logic.

column1: 【免疫负面】：免疫所有负面效果。\n异常状态表中【免疫】配置的禁止行为仅对蓝图中实现的【击飞】【击退】进行免疫。\n对于其它负面效果（buff）的免疫通过buff逻辑中的bufftag（_kBuffCategory1）进行实现。
column2: [Debuff Immunity]: Immune to all negative effects.\nThe disabled actions configured for [Immunity] in the abnormal status table only grant immunity to the [Knock-up] and [Knockback] implemented in blueprints.\nImmunity to other negative effects (buffs) is implemented via the bufftag (_kBuffCategory1) in the buff logic.
